excess_deaths: Entity: excess mortality observations by place and time; Grain: one row per (country, placename, frequency, start_date, end_date, [year/month/week]) observation period; Notable columns/keys: country, placename, frequency, start_date, end_date, year, month, week; measures: deaths, expected_deaths, excess_deaths, baseline.
mask_use_by_county: Entity: self-reported mask-use distribution for US counties; Grain: one row per county (county_fips_code); Notable columns/keys: county_fips_code; measures: never, rarely, sometimes, frequently, always (percentage or proportion of respondents in each category).
us_counties: Entity: COVID-19 case and death counts for US counties by date; Grain: one row per (date, county, county_fips_code) reporting day; Notable columns/keys: date, county, state_name, county_fips_code; measures: confirmed_cases, deaths.
us_states: Entity: COVID-19 case and death counts for US states by date; Grain: one row per (date, state_name, state_fips_code) reporting day; Notable columns/keys: date, state_name, state_fips_code; measures: confirmed_cases, deaths.
